calculation_handling.description: A portable classroom building may be on a lot with a lawfully existing school if it complies with Section 150.48 and the zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Portable classroom buildings and lawfully existing status are not modelled.

150.48.60.1(1).explanation: A portable classroom building may be placed on a lot with a lawfully existing public or private school if it complies with Section 150.48 and the zone rules.
